header.name: Analog CMOS Circuit Design
header.description: This course introduces the basic analog building blocks and quantifies their performance parameters. More advanced circuits are derived from these basic building blocks. Concepts of feedback and stability are introduced to enable analysis of complex circuits. The course also includes a self-learning lab component in which the students are expected to learn circuit simulation and design tools such as LTSpice, Eldo, Cadence Analog Suite etc. A design project is an essential component of this course.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to analyze CMOS active circuits.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to analyze circuits such as Current Mirror, Linear Amplifier, Differential Amplifier, Power Amplifier etc.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to acquire the ability to solve, analyze, design, and simulate moderately complex MOS based circuits.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to use standard commercial tools such as ELDO and Cadence Suite

lecture_topics: introduction to layouts and industry design flow for analog circuits (design flow for analog circuits, introduction to layout, case study)
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: LTSpice, Cadence Suite, and Eldo Tutorials by TAs

lecture_topics: Single Stage MOS Amplifiers (Intro to CS, CD, CG Amplifiers, analysis of CS amplifier with resistive load, analysis of CS amplifier with diode connected load, analysis of CS amplifier with current source load)
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Students to first analyze some circuits and then verify using LTSpice and Eldo (HA#1)

lecture_topics: Analysis of CS amplifier with source degeneration
analysis of cascode and folded cascade
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Students to first analyze some circuits and then verify using LTSpice and Eldo (HA#2 and HA#3)

lecture_topics: common mode properties of current mirror
Differential amplifier (single ended operation, differential mode operation, common mode response, common mode rejection)
Differential amplifier (differential pair with active loads, cascade differential amplifier)
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Students to first analyze some circuits and then verify using LTSpice and Eldo (HA#4 and HA#5)

lecture_topics: Frequency Response (fundamental concepts, relationship between transfer function and frequency response, Bode’s Rules, Association of Poles with Nodes, Miller Effect and Miller’s Theorem and its dual, General Frequency Response, Frequency Response of CS Amplifier, Frequency Response of Differential Amplifier)
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Students to first analyze some circuits and then verify using LTSpice and Eldo (HA#6 and HA#7)

lecture_topics: Multi-stage Op Amps (one-stage and two- stage Op Amps, Comparison, Common-Mode Feedback, Input Range Limitations, Slew Rate)
Noise in CMOS Circuits (Concepts, PSD, PDF, Noise in Single Stage Amplifier)
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Students to first analyze some circuits and then verify using LTSpice and Eldo (HA#8)

resources.title: Design of Analog CMOS Circuits, Behzad Razavi, Tata McGraw Hill
CMOS Analog Circuit Design, Allen and Holberg, 3rd Indian Edition, Oxford University Press
